questions.h: Should spec work when it is run through a symlink?
questions.today: A symlinked spec cannot find its spec folder. You have to pass --root.
questions.why: The launcher already follows the link to load the CLI. Only the folder lookup does not.
questions.change: Follow the link first, then look for the spec folder.
questions.recWhy: A symlinked spec on PATH should just work.

visual.caption: What you see when spec runs through a symlink on your PATH.

lines.t: no spec root: pass --root, set SPEC_ROOT, or run the bundled scripts/spec

questions.h: Should decisions keep their own statuses?
questions.today: Decisions use accepted and superseded. FORMAT.md says every unit uses active, deprecated or removed.
questions.why: The docs and the code disagree.
questions.change: Move decisions to active, deprecated and removed.
questions.recWhy: Accepted and superseded fit decisions. Say so in FORMAT.md.

questions.h: How should a ticket continue after three review rounds?
questions.today: It is stuck. Answering the question passes the gate, but every start is still refused.
questions.why: This is a dead end with no command out of it.
questions.change: Answering the question grants one more review round.

visual.caption: A task whose reviewer asked for changes three times.

after.note: Each answer grants one more round.
